title: Pixel Fish Ocean
description: Swim through charming pixel reefs as a plucky little fish—dodge hungry predators, gobble plankton gems, and evolve larger fins.
controls: Tap or drag to swim smoothly through ocean currents, collect food, and dodge bigger fish.

zh-CN.title: 像素鱼大冒险
zh-CN.description: 复古萌系像素海底世界像素鱼：操控小像素鱼穿梭珊瑚礁吃食成长、躲开大鱼追捕刷新深海得分！
zh-CN.controls: 点击或滑动控制像素小鱼上下游动觅食成长，避开危险大鱼刷新高分。
